title: Demo Trade!
author: metalblessing
selftext:
So I just released a free demo for the game I'm working on, Galaxiwilds. I really could use some input from anyone willing to try it out. But I also would love to play your demos and provide input in return. So please give me links to demos or prototypes you are working on and I will try them out and give you input as well. Mine is at [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4697140/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4697140/)

I'm not going to ask you to wishlist it, because you should only do that if you actually want to play it, but please let me know what you like/dont like and point me toward your own so I can return the favor.

comments.author: Natural-Rich6
comments.body:
Going to try it,
It was easy to put the game on steam?

replies.author: metalblessing
replies.body: It was easy. Steam provides a checklist for your store page and for your demo. $100 fee for a store page per game. Overall it was easy but there were several waiting periods. a 3-5 day approval for the store page, then a 3-5 day approval for my demo page, then a 3-5 day approval for the actual demo. So it definitely isnt immediate.

comments.author: Undumed
comments.body:
The log channel is too small. I was using the analyze and hail, and I could not see anything happening. And I believe it is a central part of the game (more than the portraits). Also, scroll, I think it doesn't have it. If you want us to read, let us read 😝

I would make it bigger, or even be able to open it as a draggable window.

replies.author: Undumed
replies.body: The text lines when talking to them. Could it just be paragraphs, not lines, it just reminds me of the people that intro every sentence in whatsapp lol

replies.author: Undumed
replies.body: Particles, vfxs, shaders for the nebulosas, its a space game!

replies.author: metalblessing
replies.body: True, I may try to condense things, because I also noticed theres more clicking in dialogue then there needs to be.

replies.author: metalblessing
replies.body: Thanks, I have around 4 portraits per race for the most part. There are 75 total races at the moment

replies.author: metalblessing
replies.body: Good point. I will add that to my list to circle back on.

replies.author: metalblessing
replies.body: I like the idea of a detachable, modular window that can be moved. I may also explore that

replies.author: metalblessing
replies.body:
Thanks for those suggestions. I have started testing them out and so far I agree it does improve the experience. I now have a popout button on the log that opens a modular, draggable window that is fully resizable, with an increased log capacity. Also a scrollbar on the small log as well. 

Its not live in the demo at the moment but I appreciate the input

comments.author: MeasIIDX
comments.body: I like the art direction you chose! I'm just on my phone so I can't play the game yet but I am enjoying what I'm seeing.

replies.body: thank you, i tried to keep all the races uniform and the same style. I may add more animations before full release
